# OddEvenBet

OddEvenBet publishes independent, plain-English research on real-event prediction markets and licensed sports betting. We review platforms, compare them head-to-head, and explain how the market actually works — for beginners first.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://oddevenbet.com/)
- [The Essentials — how prediction markets work](https://oddevenbet.com/essentials)
- [Sports Betting Glossary](https://oddevenbet.com/glossary)
- [Prediction Markets — guides & first trades](https://oddevenbet.com/prediction-markets)
- [Major Sports — beginner guides](https://oddevenbet.com/major-sports)
- [Niche Sports — beginner guides](https://oddevenbet.com/niche-sports)
- [Reviews — the platforms hub](https://oddevenbet.com/reviews)
- [How we research & score](https://oddevenbet.com/methodology)
- [Disclosure — who pays us](https://oddevenbet.com/disclosure)
- [Responsible gambling](https://oddevenbet.com/responsible-gambling)

## Notes

- English is the primary language; Chinese (/zh) and Spanish (/es) versions are available.
- The Essentials and Glossary pages carry no affiliate links — they are written to explain, not to sell.
- Some links on review and comparison pages are affiliate links; see the disclosure page for how that works.
- Full URL list: https://oddevenbet.com/sitemap-index.xml
